units.source_text: 报纸上的报道还是老样子。

en.t: The newspaper reports were still the same as ever.

units.source_text: 那里即使有一星期的空白，也分不清它的踪迹。

en.t: Even if there was a blank of a week there, no trace of it could be made out.

units.source_text: 如果它是通往外界的窗口，那这窗玻璃多半是毛玻璃。

en.t: If it was a window onto the outside world, then the glass was probably frosted.
